# Pandora Becker Lovatto

> Portfólio de Pandora Becker Lovatto, desenvolvedora full stack no Brasil. Constrói e evolui sistemas web reais, da interface ao banco de dados, com React, Node.js, TypeScript e MySQL. Site em português e inglês.

Pandora Becker Lovatto is a full stack developer based in Brazil, working as a contractor at CONSEPRO Taquara on the city's on-street parking system and studying Information Systems at FACCAT.

## Stack

- Interface: React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS
- Server: Node.js, Express
- Data: MySQL, SQL
- Infra: deploy, Git, GitHub

## Projects

- [SparkChat](https://github.com/Plovatto/SparkChat): real-time chat with end-to-end encryption in the browser, rooms, groups, voice messages, link previews and an AI assistant. React, TypeScript, libsodium, Socket.IO, Node.js, Express, Turso, Cloudflare R2.
- [PetLand](https://github.com/Plovatto/PetLand): landing page for a fictional pet shop built as an interaction showcase, in Portuguese and English. React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Motion, i18next, EmailJS.
- [Portfolio](https://github.com/Plovatto/Portfolio): this site, a living circuit board inside a code editor interface. React, TypeScript, Vite, Cloudflare Workers.
